author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/42-polaris-nsids.md — full design doc.

## What this epic delivers
A parallel wire-format crate (`polaris-lexicons`) that mirrors a v2-federation subset of `polaris-types` via Lexicon JSON, with a hand-written bridging mapping layer. Internal model stays plain Rust; the wire model is codegen-bound and revision-policy-governed.

## v1 → v2 boundary
v1 explicitly defers Polaris-owned NSIDs (`.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` Out-of-Scope). This epic is the prerequisite for federation (#100 epic) — federation cannot transport state without a stable wire format.

## Sub-issues
- PR 1: Lexicon JSON drafts + compat policy doc
- PR 2: `polaris-lexicons` crate scaffold + `cargo xtask gen-lexicons` codegen task
- PR 3: `polaris-types::lexicon_mapping` bridge + `MappingError` + proptest round-trip
- PR 4: wasm32 CI verification + `lexicons/README.md` mapping matrix

Plus a leading resolution issue for four open design questions (NSID namespace, parallel-vs-shared types, which records get NSIDs in v2, subject identity across instances).

## Provisional answers to open questions (per design recommendations)
- Q1 NSID namespace: ship `gay.dollspace.polaris.*` on main, treat as renameable until first federation handshake. Renames are cheap because codegen.
- Q2 Type strategy: parallel types via codegen (mapping-function bridge). Cost is real (mapping + tests + dual-version coord) but the alternative locks internal evolution behind federation handshakes.
- Q3 v2 NSID scope: `escalation` only, with embedded minimal observation + evidence-pointer references. `incident` deferred. Lexicons are not lightly evolved — narrow surface is a feature.
- Q4 Subject identity: ATProto-shaped only (DID / AT-URI). Non-ATProto subjects (lists, feeds, internal aggregates) are not federable in v2.

These answers can be revised by the resolution sub-issue before PR 1 merges.

## Rust-quality notes for any downstream implementer
- The codegen output crate (`polaris-lexicons`) must have **no hand-written code** in `src/`. Diff between checked-in code and a fresh `cargo xtask gen-lexicons` run must be empty — CI enforces this. Pattern: same shape as `proto-blue-api`.
- The mapping layer (`polaris-types::lexicon_mapping`) is **the privacy boundary**. Internal-only fields (moderator IDs, audit-chain hashes) MUST be dropped here, not at a later layer. Add a `#[deny(missing_docs)]` on the mapping module and document every drop with `// privacy: <field> never federated`.
- `MappingError` is a `thiserror` enum (library-internal). Variants: `FieldOutOfRange { field: &'static str, value: String }`, `UnsupportedVariant { discriminator: &'static str }`, `MissingRequired { field: &'static str }`. Use `#[from]` only for proto-blue errors, not for `serde_json::Error` (mapping errors are structured, not free-form).
- Round-trip property tests use `proptest`. Strategy: generate via `Arbitrary` impls, map → unmap, assert equality on the in-both-representations subset. Out-of-subset fields are documented in `mapping-matrix.md` and explicitly skipped from the property assertion.
- `polaris-lexicons` Cargo.toml: `serde`, `serde_json`, `chrono` — **no `tokio`, no `reqwest`** (must build for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`). Wire validation runtime via `proto-blue-lexicon` if needed; otherwise the codegen output is self-contained.

## External references
- ATProto Lexicon spec: https://atproto.com/specs/lexicon
- ATProto NSID conventions: https://atproto.com/specs/nsid
- proto-blue codegen crate: in-repo at `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-codegen`
- proto-blue-lexicon runtime validation: `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-lexicon`
- proptest book: https://proptest-rs.github.io/proptest/proptest/index.html

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocks: #100 (M5 #43 federation epic — federation needs this wire format).
- Independent of #44-#107 (mobile, ML, ozone-migration, trust model, TPM, HW token).

Relations get wired explicitly when sub-issues are filed.
